description: This file defines the class Zend_Validate_Between, a validation class in the Zend Framework used to check if a value falls within a specified range, with options for inclusive or strict comparisons.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Between
classes.description: A validation class that checks if a value is between a minimum and maximum, with optional inclusivity.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize min, max, and inclusive options.

methods.name: getMin
methods.description: Returns the minimum value for validation.

methods.name: setMin
methods.description: Sets the minimum value for validation.

methods.name: getMax
methods.description: Returns the maximum value for validation.

methods.name: setMax
methods.description: Sets the maximum value for validation.

methods.name: getInclusive
methods.description: Returns whether the comparison is inclusive.

methods.name: setInclusive
methods.description: Sets whether the comparison is inclusive.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Checks if a given value is within the specified range based on the inclusive setting.
